I was reading something awhile back that 12 step programs are basically failure machines because they take the blame away from the person and instead place it on the disease. i.e. "It's not your fault you're an alcoholic, you have a disease," "It's not your fault you're addicted to heroin, it's a disease," "not your fault you're fat..." etc. Also, the whole "if you take one sip of alcohol ever again you're going to go right back to being a full blown drunk," so it sets a mindset where if someone slips up once then they fall right back in because they were told that's what happened.
